единицы.утверждение_en: Example prompt: an isometric cutaway infographic of the Earth's layers with labels, icons, a glowing inner core, a named style and a contrasting palette.
единицы.цитата: The Layers of the Earth, depicted as a clean, isometric cutaway illustration. Showcase the distinct layers—Crust, Mantle, Outer Core, and Inner Core—with clear labels and texture variations. Include small icons on the crust representing mountains and oceans. The Inner Core should have a subtle, radiant glow. The style is Modern Isometric Infographic, characterized by clean lines, sharp angles, and a minimalist feel. A powerful color scheme of deep earth tones, fiery oranges, and molten yellows, contrasted with a cool blue for the surface.
единицы.заметка: Структура: предмет → формат ('depicted as a clean, isometric cutaway illustration') → перечень частей через тире 'Crust, Mantle, Outer Core, and Inner Core' + 'with clear labels and texture variations' → второстепенные элементы (icons) → эффект для одной части (radiant glow) → стиль названием и тут же расшифровкой ('The style is Modern Isometric Infographic, characterized by clean lines, sharp angles, and a minimalist feel') → палитра с контрастным цветом. Работу делают: явный список подписываемых частей, стиль = имя + определение, палитра с контрастом. Результат по alt: разрез Земли с подписями слоёв.

единицы.утверждение_en: Example prompt: a short triptych infographic comparing three named cloud types, one per panel with a bold label, in high-contrast comic style.
единицы.цитата: Triptych infographic comparing three types of clouds: Cumulus, Stratus, and Cirrus. Each panel shows the cloud type in a dramatic sky with a bold label. High-contrast comic style.
единицы.заметка: Короткий промпт: формат ('Triptych infographic comparing three types') + названные объекты + правило на каждую панель ('Each panel shows… with a bold label') + стиль-тег в конце. Содержательные детали (по alt: fair-weather, light rain, 'mare's tails', ice crystals) модель добавила сама из знаний о мире — демонстрация 'real-world knowledge'.

единицы.утверждение_en: Template: "Create an image of <real landmark>. In the style of <style>, no text. Your plan is to first search for visual references, and generate after. Aspect ratio 16:9." — used with Museum Clos Lucé (color chalk sketch; ink sketch; bright colored Synthetic Cubism) and Bletchley Park Mansion (bright colored Synthetic Cubism).
единицы.цитата: Create an image of Museum Clos Lucé. In the style of a color chalk sketch, no text. Your plan is to first search for visual references, and generate after. Aspect ratio 16:9.
единицы.заметка: Четыре почти одинаковых промпта (строки 320, 322, 324, 336), различаются объектом и стилем. Работу делают: реальное название места; явный план 'first search for visual references, and generate after' (инструкция сначала искать референсы — задействует поиск изображений); отрицание 'no text'; соотношение сторон текстом в конце. По alt-текстам результаты показаны парами 'Nano Banana' (слева) vs 'Nano Banana 2' (справа): у первого — вымышленный замок (дракон, пропеллер, фиолетовые башни), у NB2 — кирпичная усадьба, ближе к реальному объекту.

единицы.утверждение_en: Example prompt: flat-lay photography of a DIY water-cycle infographic with left-to-right steps, hand-drawn arrows, top-down view and soft even lighting.
единицы.цитата: High-quality flat lay photography creating a DIY infographic that simply explains how the water cycle works, arranged on a clean, light gray textured background. The visual story flows from left to right in clear steps. Simple, clean black arrows are hand-drawn onto the background to guide the viewer's eye. The overall mood is educational, modern, and easy to understand. The image is shot from a top-down, bird's-eye view with soft, even lighting that minimizes shadows and keeps the focus on the process.
единицы.заметка: Порядок: медиум ('High-quality flat lay photography') → назначение ('simply explains how the water cycle works') → фон → направление чтения ('flows from left to right in clear steps') → навигация взгляда (hand-drawn black arrows) → настроение → камера ('top-down, bird's-eye view') → свет ('soft, even lighting that minimizes shadows'). Работу делает сочетание 'фото физической поделки' + явный маршрут взгляда. По alt: модель сама выбрала материалы (вата, бусины, фетр) и подписи этапов.

единицы.утверждение_en: Example prompt: a rustic hand-drawn baker's guide comparing four flours (protein content, best uses, texture) displayed as sacks of flour.
единицы.цитата: A baker's guide to different types of flour (e.g., All-Purpose, Bread, Cake, Whole Wheat). A rustic, hand-drawn style comparing the protein content, best uses, and texture of each flour, displayed as sacks of flour.
единицы.заметка: Тема + примеры в скобках '(e.g., All-Purpose, Bread, Cake, Whole Wheat)' + стиль + оси сравнения ('comparing the protein content, best uses, and texture') + визуальная метафора ('displayed as sacks of flour'). Фактические данные (проценты белка, по alt) модель берёт из знаний о мире — сюда же относится предупреждение раздела Limitations о проверке данных.

единицы.утверждение_en: Example prompt: a whimsical storybook-style infographic on regrowing vegetables from scraps, with a central anthropomorphic ginger root, labeled surrounding illustrations, quoted box titles and icons, style and palette.
единицы.цитата: Kitchen scraps sprouting on a magical kitchen counter, presented as a charming educational whimsical cartoon/illustrated storybook infographic on how to regrow vegetables from leftovers. A main central illustration features a whimsical cartoon of a ginger root with tiny, expressive arms and legs excitedly sprouting green shoots, surrounded by magical sparkles and a soft glow, surrounded by smaller, labeled playful illustrations of an onion bottom growing new green tops in a cup, celery stalks regrowing in water, and sweet potato vines emerging from a tuber. Informational boxes detail 'Easy Re-grow Examples', 'Simple Water & Light Needs', and 'The Joy of Zero-Waste Gardening'. Include a close-up of a tiny, smiling cartoon sprout emerging from a potato eye, and whimsical icons for 'Magic Seed', 'Heartfelt Growth', and 'Smiling Sun'. The style is whimsical cartoon illustration with soft lines, expressive characters, and a joyful, imaginative quality. Bright greens, cheerful yellows, rosy pinks, and warm browns color palette. Informative and aesthetic layout.
единицы.заметка: Иерархия: сцена → формат ('educational whimsical cartoon/illustrated storybook infographic on how to…') → центральная иллюстрация с деталями → окружающие подписанные мини-иллюстрации → информационные блоки с заголовками в кавычках ('Easy Re-grow Examples' и др.) → крупный план → иконки с названиями в кавычках → стиль → палитра → 'Informative and aesthetic layout.' Работу делают: центр/периферия и точные тексты в кавычках. По alt: модель добавила заголовок 'Kitchen Scrap Magic'.

единицы.утверждение_en: Example prompt: a process shown as a golden path connecting meadow → beehive → centrifuge → jar, with bees, a labeled palette and '16:9 aspect ratio, isometric infographic' as closing tags.
единицы.цитата: A golden-yellow path connects a flowered meadow to a wooden beehive, then to a honey-spinning centrifuge, and finally a glass jar. Small stylized bees fly along the path. Palette: Honey gold, white, and sage green. 16:9 aspect ratio, isometric infographic.
единицы.заметка: Последовательность процесса закодирована связующим путём ('connects… then to… and finally…'); палитра задана меткой 'Palette:'; формат и соотношение сторон — тегами в конце. По alt: модель сама пронумеровала 4 этапа и добавила заголовок 'The Honey Production Process'.

единицы.утверждение_en: Example prompt: an educational recycling infographic with a central recycling symbol surrounded by labeled diagrams and boxes whose exact labels are given in quoted capitals, plus style and palette.
единицы.цитата: Create an image of the basic principles of recycling, presented as a clear and helpful educational infographic featuring a main central illustration of the three chasing arrows of the recycling symbol. This scene should be surrounded by smaller, labeled diagrams and informational boxes with clear headings, including icons for different material types like "PAPER", "PLASTICS", and "GLASS & METAL", a diagram showing "HOW TO PREPARE ITEMS" (rinse and dry), and a small illustration of a "MATERIALS RECOVERY FACILITY". The style is a hand-drawn illustration with clean line art and soft, digital gouache textures, using a classic recycling color palette of greens, blues, and neutral grays in an informative and eco-friendly layout.
единицы.заметка: 'Create an image of <тема>, presented as a clear and helpful educational infographic featuring a main central illustration of…' → окружение 'smaller, labeled diagrams and informational boxes with clear headings' → точные подписи заглавными в кавычках ('PAPER', 'PLASTICS', 'GLASS & METAL', 'HOW TO PREPARE ITEMS', 'MATERIALS RECOVERY FACILITY') → стиль (hand-drawn, clean line art, digital gouache textures) → палитра → layout.

единицы.утверждение_en: Example prompt: an ekphrastic, art-critic style description of abstract etched/woodcut-like line typography reading 'Wave' above 'Form', white on black, aspect ratio 16:9.
единицы.цитата: This visual presents a stark dichotomy, a bold interplay of light and profound shadow, where geometric and organic shapes emerge from the darkness with an almost sculptural quality. The image employs a meticulously crafted linear texture, where fine, closely packed parallels define the contours and suggest volume, akin to a precise etching or a sophisticated woodcut. These intricate striations create an optical illusion of three-dimensionality, giving the forms a tangible, almost tactile presence against the unbreachable void. The forms themselves hint at an arrangement of characters, possibly a two-tiered inscription of “Wave” above and “Form” below, though rendered in an abstract, avant-garde typography that emphasizes form over immediate legibility. Gradient transitions within the patterned elements suggest varying degrees of illumination, as if an unseen light source casts soft, diffused highlights and deeper, softer depressions across their curved surfaces. Each individual component, whether spherical or elongated, possesses a unique shading, contributing to the overall sense of depth and intricate design. The entire composition is a masterful exercise in contrasts, utilizing only white against an unbroken dark expanse to convey both message and profound artistic expression. Aspect ratio 16:9.
единицы.заметка: Промпт написан как описание готовой работы (язык искусствоведа): контраст, 'linear texture… akin to a precise etching or a sophisticated woodcut', текст задан с позицией ('“Wave” above and “Form” below') и прямо допускает приоритет формы над читаемостью ('emphasizes form over immediate legibility'); 'only white against an unbroken dark expanse'; AR в конце. По alt: результат — 'WAVE FORM' из параллельных белых линий.

единицы.утверждение_en: Example prompt: a candid street photograph of wheat-pasted 'Indie Film Fest' posters with 'DOWNTOWN LA' below, three alternating palettes, paste sheen, layered torn posters, diffused daylight, slightly low angle and grain.
единицы.цитата: A candid photograph captures a vibrant row of freshly wheat-pasted posters adhered to a heavily textured, dark green urban wall in Downtown Los Angeles. The posters are for an "Indie Film Fest," with "DOWNTOWN LA" printed in smaller letters directly below. The bold design alternates across three distinct color palettes: one with an electric purple background and orange and white text, the next a blazing orange background with lime green and white text, and the third a lime green background with purple and white text, creating a pulsating visual rhythm down the line. The edges of the posters show minor wrinkles and the damp sheen of the paste. They are layered haphazardly over older, torn and faded posters in shades of grey, blue, and brown, whose ragged edges and fragments provide a textured history beneath the newer, bright ones. The surrounding wall is rough concrete with patches of peeling paint, graffiti tags in black and white, and some grime. The lighting is diffused daylight, illuminating the street scene. The image is taken from a slightly low angle, looking slightly down the length of the wall on a sidewalk, with blurred pedestrians and traffic in the background on a slightly hazy day. The photo has a slightly grainy texture.
единицы.заметка: Порядок: тип снимка ('A candid photograph captures') → место → текст в кавычках с иерархией ('with “DOWNTOWN LA” printed in smaller letters directly below') → три чередующиеся палитры, каждая расписана (фон + цвета текста) → физика материала (морщины, влажный блеск клея) → слои старых афиш → стена → свет → ракурс камеры → размытый фон → зерно. Работу делают точный текст + размер/позиция + материальные признаки реализма.

единицы.утверждение_en: Example prompt: a 'New Job' card on black glass, navy/gold/white palette, debossed gold-foil icon, two quoted messages each with its own font (classic serif in gold ink; elegant sans-serif), matte thick card stock.
единицы.цитата: A sophisticated ‘New Job’ card is laid flat on a sleek, minimalist surface, perhaps black glass, with a subtle reflection. The design is elegant and empowering, featuring a distinguished color palette of deep navy blue, shimmering gold, and crisp white. The central graphic is a minimalist icon of a mountain peak or an upward-growing graph, subtly debossed into the card with gold foil accents, symbolizing achievement and growth. The text, “Congratulations on your exciting new adventure!” is inscribed in a refined, classic serif font, printed in gold ink. The message, “Wishing you success, fulfillment, and happiness in your new role,” is in a complementary, elegant sans-serif font. The card stock is thick and features a luxurious, smooth matte finish, providing a premium feel. The overall aesthetic is one of understated excellence and aspiration, celebrating a career milestone with grace and professionalism.
единицы.заметка: Шаблон 'открытки' (см. длинную дистанцию): объект + поверхность → характер дизайна → палитра из трёх цветов → центральная графика + техника (debossed, gold foil) + смысл → текст 1 в кавычках + шрифт + цвет печати → текст 2 в кавычках + шрифт → бумага и отделка → общее впечатление. По alt: тексты отрисованы, второе сообщение — белым (цвет в промпте не задан).

единицы.утверждение_en: Example prompt: a studio photo of a retro 'happy birthday' card at a diagonal angle with shadow, stippled interlocking lettering in vibrant yellow, aspect ratio 16:9.
единицы.цитата: This is a high-quality studio photograph of a vibrant and modern “Happy Birthday” greeting card, presented against a plain, light-gray background. The card itself is positioned at a dynamic diagonal angle, leaning back and to the right, which creates a distinct, dark gray shadow beneath it, giving the object a strong sense of depth and presence. The surface of these robust characters is adorned with an intricate pattern of small, uniformly spaced dark circles, lending a tactile quality to their otherwise solid form. This stippled effect, reminiscent of vintage printing techniques, provides a subtle contrast against the vibrant yellow. The individual components of the word form an interconnected, almost labyrinthine structure, where each segment of the lettering appears to interlock. The overall composition conveys a sense of energetic retro-modernism, while the slight creasing visible on the dark canvas hints at a well-worn, authentic aesthetic. This distinctive emblem spells out the word “happy birthday”, its stylized geometry commanding attention amidst the subdued ground. Aspect ratio 16:9.
единицы.заметка: Открывается постановкой съёмки ('high-quality studio photograph… presented against a plain, light-gray background', 'dynamic diagonal angle, leaning back and to the right', тень) → фактура букв (точечный узор, винтажная печать) → сцепленные сегменты букв → стиль (retro-modernism) → слово задано в конце ('spells out the word “happy birthday”') → AR. Текст местами ссылается на 'these robust characters' без ввода — промпт похож на авто-описание изображения. По alt: тёмно-синяя открытка с жёлтыми буквами.

единицы.утверждение_en: Example prompt: a friendship card on a chunky knit sweater, mustard/denim/beige palette, hand-drawn hands-or-heart graphic, long quoted message in flowing script and 'Thank you!' in bolder sans-serif, linen texture.
единицы.цитата: This warm friendship card is artfully placed on a soft, textured fabric surface, perhaps a chunky knit sweater, suggesting comfort and closeness. The design is heartfelt and approachable, with a cozy color palette of warm mustard yellow, soft denim blue, and creamy beige. The central graphic is a simple, hand-drawn illustration of two intertwining hands or a stylized heart, rendered with a slightly imperfect, charming quality. The typography for “So grateful for your wonderful friendship. You bring so much joy and laughter into my life” is in a friendly, flowing script font that feels personal and sincere. The “Thank you!” is in a slightly bolder, complementary sans-serif font. The card stock has a subtle, tactile linen texture, enhancing the feeling of authenticity and warmth. The overall impression is one of genuine appreciation and the comforting bond of friendship.
единицы.заметка: Шаблон открытки; поверхность задаёт настроение ('suggesting comfort and closeness'); центральная графика дана с альтернативой ('two intertwining hands or a stylized heart'); длинный текст в кавычках + шрифт; второй текст + более жирный шрифт. По alt: руки, образующие сердце, текст отрисован целиком.

единицы.утверждение_en: Example prompt: a new-baby card propped against a footprint-decorated wall, yellow/turquoise/white palette, flat hot-air-balloon graphic, two quoted messages with specified fonts (rounded sans-serif with varied letter heights; clear sans-serif), semi-gloss finish.
единицы.цитата: This vibrant new baby card, perfect for a gender reveal or gender-neutral celebration, is propped playfully against a wall adorned with tiny, colorful footprints. The design is modern and joyful, featuring a playful color palette of bright yellow, vivid turquoise, and crisp white. The central graphic is a minimalist illustration of a hot air balloon carrying a tiny ‘bundle,’ rendered in bold, flat colors. “Congratulations on your precious new arrival!” is in a whimsical, rounded sans-serif font, with slight variations in letter height for a fun effect. The message, “May your hearts be filled with endless love and joy,” is in a clear, friendly sans-serif font. The card has a smooth, semi-gloss finish, making the colors pop. The overall aesthetic is one of energetic celebration and modern charm, announcing the new arrival with a cheerful flair.
единицы.заметка: Шаблон открытки; у шрифта задан приём ('with slight variations in letter height for a fun effect'). Тот же текст повторно используется как Prompt 1 в разделе локализации (строка 384).

единицы.утверждение_en: Example prompt (4 paragraphs): studio photo setup → card face of overlapping circles with gold-foil accents → 'Happy Birthday' arched along a circle's curve in looping gold-foil script → lighting contrasting matte vs foil and uncoated cardstock.
единицы.цитата:
This is a high-quality studio photograph of a cheerful and contemporary “Happy Birthday” greeting card, presented against a plain, light-gray background. The card itself is positioned at a dynamic diagonal angle, leaning back and to the right, which creates a distinct, dark gray shadow beneath it, giving the object a strong sense of depth and presence. 
The face of the card features a celebratory cascade of overlapping circles in varying sizes. The design creates a bubbly, effervescent effect, with larger, semi-translucent circles layered over smaller, opaque ones. The palette is a cool and sophisticated mix of deep teal, soft lavender, and mint green, accented with a few circles in a shimmering gold foil that catches the light. 
The greeting “Happy Birthday” is elegantly arched across the upper portion of the card, following the curve of one of the larger circles. The typography is a delicate, looping script font, rendered in the same metallic gold foil as the accents, which makes it pop against the cooler tones of the background. The flowing letters add a touch of personal, handwritten warmth to the modern geometric design. 
The lighting is soft and even, beautifully highlighting the contrast between the matte finish of the colored circles and the brilliant shine of the gold foil. The premium cardstock has a subtle, uncoated texture, enhancing its high-quality feel.
единицы.заметка: Абзац на аспект: (1) постановка съёмки — тот же вступительный абзац, что в строке 362; (2) дизайн лицевой стороны, размеры/прозрачность кругов, палитра + акценты фольгой; (3) текст: размещение привязано к элементу дизайна ('arched across the upper portion of the card, following the curve of one of the larger circles') + шрифт того же материала, что акценты; (4) свет и материал (матовое vs блеск фольги). По alt: надпись в результате — 'across a white banner in the center', т.е. размещение из промпта выполнено не буквально.

единицы.утверждение_en: Example prompt: a get-well card on a white surface, lime/orange/white palette, geometric-shapes-or-smiling-sun graphic, headline in bold angled sans-serif, message in clear sans-serif, semi-gloss finish.
единицы.цитата: A cheerful get well card, bursting with positive energy, is propped on a bright, clean white surface. The design is vibrant and modern, with a bold color scheme of lime green, bright orange, and a crisp white. The main graphic is a playful arrangement of geometric shapes (circles, triangles, squares) forming an abstract, uplifting pattern, or a stylized, smiling sun. “Hope you’re feeling better soon!” is in a bold, dynamic sans-serif font, slightly angled to convey enthusiasm. The message, “Sending healing thoughts and wishes for a speedy recovery. Take care!” is in a clear, modern sans-serif font. The card has a semi-gloss finish, making the colors incredibly vivid and impactful. The overall impression is one of energetic cheerfulness, designed to instantly lift spirits and convey strong wishes for a quick return to health.
единицы.заметка: Шаблон открытки; наклон заголовка задан с мотивом ('slightly angled to convey enthusiasm'); графика с альтернативой ('or a stylized, smiling sun'). По alt: заголовок отрисован заглавными, модель добавила тюльпаны на фоне.

единицы.утверждение_en: Example prompt (4 paragraphs): same studio setup → concentric diamonds with colors ordered from outer band to center → 'HAPPY' along the top edge and 'BIRTHDAY' along the bottom in wide all-caps white sans-serif → direct frontal lighting for flat saturated color, matte varnish.
единицы.цитата:
This is a high-quality studio photograph of a dazzling and energetic “Happy Birthday” greeting card, presented against a plain, light-gray background. The card itself is positioned at a dynamic diagonal angle, leaning back and to the right, which creates a distinct, dark gray shadow beneath it, giving the object a strong sense of depth and presence. 
The card’s design features a large, central diamond composed of a series of smaller, concentric diamonds nested inside one another. This creates a hypnotic, pulsating effect. Each band is filled with a different, high-impact flat color, creating a vibrant spectrum: an outer band of electric fuchsia is followed by tangerine orange, lemon yellow, and finally a deep violet at the very center. The color application is perfectly uniform and bold. 
The words “HAPPY” and “BIRTHDAY” are split to frame the central shape. “HAPPY” is printed in a wide, all-caps, sans-serif font along the top edge of the diamond, while “BIRTHDAY” mirrors it along the bottom. Rendered in a solid, bright white, the letters stand out sharply, their clean lines cutting cleanly across the multiple color bands of the geometric pattern. 
The lighting is direct and frontal, ensuring that the colors appear exceptionally saturated and completely flat. The premium cardstock has a smooth, velvety finish, achieved with a matte varnish that enriches the colors and gives the card a substantial, high-quality feel without any distracting shine.
единицы.заметка: Работу делают: явный порядок цветов ('an outer band of electric fuchsia is followed by tangerine orange, lemon yellow, and finally a deep violet at the very center'); раскладка текста относительно центральной фигуры (слова разделены и обрамляют ромб); свет выбран под задачу ('direct and frontal, ensuring that the colors appear exceptionally saturated and completely flat'). Первый абзац идентичен первому абзацу строки 355.

единицы.утверждение_en: Example prompt: a thank-you card on a sunny yellow background, fuchsia/sky-blue/white polka-dot confetti pattern, 'Thank You!' in chunky sans-serif with a slight 3D shadow, quoted message in clean sans-serif, glossy finish.
единицы.цитата: A bright and cheerful thank you card is set against a sunny yellow background, casting a soft shadow. The design is playful and modern, featuring a vibrant color palette of fuchsia, sky blue, and white. The main graphic is a whimsical pattern of small, overlapping polka dots in fuchsia and blue, creating a confetti-like effect. “Thank You!” is boldly written in a chunky, friendly sans-serif font, with a slight 3D shadow effect, making it pop. The message, “So grateful for your kindness and generosity. Your thoughtfulness truly brightened my day,” is presented in a clean, straightforward sans-serif font. The card has a glossy finish, enhancing the vividness of the colors. The overall impression is one of enthusiastic and heartfelt appreciation, delivered with a burst of joyful energy.
единицы.заметка: Шаблон открытки; эффект шрифта задан словами ('with a slight 3D shadow effect, making it pop'). По alt: результат соответствует, добавлена ваза с цветами.

единицы.утверждение_en: Example prompt (3 paragraphs): studio shot at three-quarter angle → stacked left-aligned white sans-serif 'happy birthday', perfectly kerned, with each letter filled by a multicolored checkerboard of named colors → effect and diffuse lighting on matte stock.
единицы.цитата:
This is an expertly lit studio shot showcasing a modern, graphically-driven “Happy Birthday” card against a stark, light gray background. The card is presented at a three-quarter angle, tilted slightly backward and to the right, casting a soft yet defined shadow that grounds the object in the space and gives it a tangible, three-dimensional quality. 
The design of the card is a masterclass in minimalist celebration. It features a bold, sans-serif typeface in a crisp white, with the words “happy birthday” arranged in a stacked, left-aligned format. The letters are perfectly kerned and possess a clean, geometric precision. The true focal point is the brilliant, multicolored checkerboard pattern that fills the interior of each letter. This intricate infill is composed of tiny, perfect squares in a vibrant and joyful palette, including shades of sunshine yellow, electric blue, mint green, warm orange, and flamingo pink. 
This clever design choice creates a dynamic contrast between the simple, uniform shape of the white letters and the complex, festive mosaic within them. The overall effect is one of controlled chaos—a burst of celebratory confetti contained within a sleek, contemporary typographic structure. The lighting is even and diffuse, emphasizing the matte finish of the cardstock and the rich saturation of the colors.
единицы.заметка: Точная типографика: регистр/выключка ('stacked, left-aligned'), кернинг, заливка букв паттерном с перечнем цветов; третий абзац объясняет замысел ('controlled chaos'). По alt: в результате цветной сеткой залиты только внутрибуквенные просветы (counters) букв a, p, y, b, d — частичное исполнение.

единицы.утверждение_en: Nano Banana 2 can translate text into different languages or localize what is already inside an image, and can change a photo's environment and context (e.g. the Mumbai coast into Tokyo's skyline).
единицы.цитата: Translate text into different languages, or localize what’s already inside your image. You can even change the environment and context of a photo, like switching the Mumbai coast into Tokyo’s skyline.

единицы.утверждение_en: Example prompt (turn 1 of a localization sequence): a naturalistic cinematic close-up of a small illustrated recycled-material sign with the quoted text 'Native Wildlife: Please Observe from a Distance.' in delicate script, soft light through fern leaves, blurred foliage.
единицы.цитата: An intimate, naturalistic cinematic close-up reveals a small, intricately illustrated sign made of recycled material, showing drawings of local birds and flowers. Delicate script below reads: "Native Wildlife: Please Observe from a Distance." Soft, diffused light filters through the leaves of a nearby fern, casting gentle shadows. The background is a soft blur of vibrant green foliage, emphasizing respect for the delicate ecosystem.
единицы.заметка: Текст в кавычках с указанием шрифта и места ('Delicate script below reads:'); свет с источником ('filters through the leaves of a nearby fern'); фон размыт. Это исходный кадр для Prompt 2/3 (локализация).

единицы.утверждение_en: Example follow-up prompt: 'Take this concept and localize it to an Indian setting, including translation of all the text to Hindi.'
единицы.цитата: Take this concept and localize it to an Indian setting, including translation of all the text to Hindi.
единицы.заметка: Шаг 2 мультихода: ссылка на предыдущий результат ('this concept') + целевая среда ('an Indian setting') + явный охват перевода ('all the text') + язык. По alt (24): итог — версии знака на хинди и немецком.

единицы.утверждение_en: Example follow-up prompt: 'Localize this image to a German environment, including translation of all the text to German.'
единицы.цитата: Localize this image to a German environment, including translation of all the text to German.
единицы.заметка: Та же схема, что шаг 2, но ссылка на 'this image' и 'environment' вместо 'setting'.

единицы.утверждение_en: Example follow-up edit prompt: 'Translate text to Spanish, keep the same text style.'
единицы.цитата: Translate text to Spanish, keep the same text style.
единицы.заметка: Минимальная правка: действие + оговорка сохранения ('keep the same text style'). По alt (25): текст переведён ('¡Felicitaciones por la llegada de su precioso bebé!…'), композиция та же.

единицы.утверждение_en: Nano Banana 2 can upscale images into 2K and 4K in seconds.
единицы.цитата: Upscale images into 2K and 4K in seconds to keep visuals sharp, vibrant, and production-ready.
единицы.заметка: Как именно вызывается апскейл (параметр или промпт) — не сказано.

единицы.утверждение_en: Nano Banana 2 can switch aspect ratios from square to portrait to landscape, e.g. for a vertical social post or a widescreen backdrop.
единицы.цитата: Whether you need a vertical social post or a widescreen backdrop, effortlessly switch aspect ratios from square to portrait to landscape.
единицы.заметка: Список поддерживаемых соотношений не дан.

единицы.утверждение_en: Nano Banana 2 can carry the consistency and resemblance of up to five characters and the fidelity of up to fourteen objects across a single workflow, keeping subjects recognizable from scene to scene.
единицы.цитата: Carry the consistency and resemblance of up to five characters – and the fidelity of up to fourteen objects – across a single workflow. Subjects stay recognizable from scene to scene to build narratives with better visual continuity.
единицы.заметка: Числа: до 5 персонажей и до 14 объектов 'across a single workflow' — не сказано, это на запрос или на цепочку. Ср. промпты ниже с '14 characters' (см. противоречия).

единицы.утверждение_en: Example prompt with reference images: 'Create an image of these 14 characters and items having fun at the farm…' with a strict identity-consistency clause.
единицы.цитата: Create an image of these 14 characters and items having fun at the farm. The overall atmosphere is fun, silly and joyful. It is strictly important to keep identity consistent of all the 14 characters and items.
единицы.заметка: 'these 14 characters and items' ссылается на приложенные референсы (по alt: слева — отдельные войлочные персонажи/предметы, справа — итог). Число названо явно; атмосфера одной фразой; усиленная формулировка важности ('It is strictly important to keep identity consistent of all the 14 characters and items').

единицы.утверждение_en: Example prompt used with six reference images: a long macro photographic description of a jeweled mechanical insect on a lace-like floral base (camera angle, colors, lighting, materials, background, overall impression).
единицы.цитата: This is a captivating close-up photograph of an intricately designed, mechanical insect, reminiscent of a butterfly or dragonfly, perched delicately amidst a soft, ethereal floral arrangement. The photography style is highly detailed and almost macro, showcasing the exquisite craftsmanship of the subject. The camera angle is slightly elevated, looking down upon the insect and the surrounding elements, creating a sense of intimacy and wonder. The dominant colors are soft whites, creams, and light blues, with striking accents of gold, silver, and vibrant teal and orange on the insect's body. The lighting is soft and diffused, highlighting the translucent quality of the insect's wings and the gentle textures of the flowers. There's a subtle glow that suggests either natural daylight or a carefully placed artificial light source, creating gentle shadows that add depth. The main subject is the elaborate mechanical insect, which features translucent, veined wings with delicate gold and silver filigree patterns and embedded jewels. Its body is a mosaic of tiny gears, polished metal, and sparkling gemstones, with a segment of its abdomen adorned in bright teal and orange enamel. Its delicate, jointed legs are made of polished silver and clear glass-like tubes, and it has fine antennae extending from its head. The insect is resting on a cluster of soft, white, organic-looking forms, some resembling unfurling petals or intricate lace. In the blurred background, out-of-focus white flowers with subtle yellow or red centers add to the dreamy, serene atmosphere. The overall impression is one of delicate beauty, precision engineering, and a blend of natural and artificial elegance.
единицы.заметка: По alt (27) к промпту приложены 6 изображений (настоящая стрекоза, золотая филигрань, бирюзовая эмаль, белая роза, кружево, голубые цветы); промпт не ссылается на них явно, а описывает итоговый сплав. Порядок: тип фото → стиль (macro) → ракурс ('slightly elevated, looking down') → доминирующие цвета → свет → главный объект по материалам → опора → фон → общее впечатление.

единицы.утверждение_en: Example prompt used with six reference images: 'The girl walking ahead on the path with her umbrella and her dog trailing behind her with a red ball. The small bird observes the girl from the fence.'
единицы.цитата: The girl walking ahead on the path with her umbrella and her dog trailing behind her with a red ball. The small bird observes the girl from the fence.
единицы.заметка: По alt (28) 6 входных изображений (осенний пейзаж, девочка, терьер, красный зонт, красный мяч, воробей). Промпт задаёт только действия и пространственные отношения ('walking ahead', 'trailing behind', 'observes… from the fence') и называет сущности определённым артиклем; внешность и палитру несут референсы.

единицы.утверждение_en: Example prompt: 'A medium shot of the 14 fluffy characters are on the bleachers…' at a figure-skating finale, with a strict identity-and-attire consistency clause.
единицы.цитата: A medium shot of the 14 fluffy characters are on the bleachers, completely captivated by the end of a figure skating performance. The overall atmosphere is fun and cheerful. It is strictly important to keep identity and attire consistent of all the 14 characters.
единицы.заметка: Тип плана первым ('A medium shot'); число персонажей названо; оговорка консистентности расширена на одежду ('keep identity and attire consistent of all the 14 characters'). Грамматика неровная ('of the 14… are') — не мешает. По alt: 14 монстров на трибунах катка.

единицы.утверждение_en: Nano Banana 2 can generate multiple images with just one prompt to explore different creative avenues.
единицы.цитата: Explore different creative avenues in seconds by generating multiple images with just one prompt.

единицы.утверждение_en: Example prompt: a funny 6-part story of 3 reference characters building a tree house, with a narrative arc, fixed identity/attire, varying expressions and angles, one of each character per image, and 'Generate 6 images one at a time… separate output in 16:9 format.'
единицы.цитата: Create a funny 6 part story with these 3 fluffy friends building a tree house. The story is thrilling throughout with emotional highs and lows and is ending in a happy moment. Keep the attire and identity consistent of all 3 characters, but their expressions and angles should vary throughout all 6 images. Make sure to only have one of each character in each image. Generate 6 images one at a time. Each image should be a separate output in 16:9 format.
единицы.заметка: Структура: задача и число кадров ('a funny 6 part story with these 3 fluffy friends') → драматургия ('thrilling throughout with emotional highs and lows and is ending in a happy moment') → что фиксировано и что меняется ('Keep the attire and identity consistent… but their expressions and angles should vary') → ограничение дублей ('only have one of each character in each image') → инструкция вывода ('Generate 6 images one at a time. Each image should be a separate output in 16:9 format.'). По alt (31): 3 входных персонажа, сетка из 6 результатов.

единицы.утверждение_en: Example prompt: 'Cinematic still in the style of a surreal dream sequence' — full shot of a woman in a field, slightly low angle, billowing pastel layered dress, pink hair, golden grassland and mountains, soft diffused light, balanced composition.
единицы.цитата: Cinematic still in the style of a surreal dream sequence with a full shot of a woman standing in a field. The camera captures her from a slightly low angle, emphasizing the dramatic flow and volume of her fantastical garment. The dress is a multi-layered creation of sheer fabrics in pastel shades of lime green, pale pink, and soft yellow, billowing around her as if caught in a gentle breeze, creating abstract shapes and a sense of weightlessness. The woman has short, light pink-toned hair and a delicate expression. The background consists of a vast, golden grassland stretching towards distant, softly rendered mountains under a clear, light sky. The lighting is soft and diffused, contributing to the ethereal and dreamlike quality of the scene. The composition is carefully balanced, with the woman positioned centrally yet surrounded by the expansive landscape and the dynamic movement of her clothing. The overall ambiance is one of quiet fantasy and poetic motion, reminiscent of scenes that blur the lines between reality and imagination, with a focus on visual fluidity and gentle color transitions.
единицы.заметка: Порядок: медиум + жанр ('Cinematic still in the style of a surreal dream sequence') + план ('full shot') → ракурс с целью ('slightly low angle, emphasizing the dramatic flow and volume of her fantastical garment') → костюм (слои, ткани, цвета, движение) → волосы/выражение → фон → свет → композиция → общее настроение. Стиль задан жанром, без имён авторов.

единицы.утверждение_en: Example prompt: a cinematic still 'crafted with a wide-angle lens from an extremely low perspective' of a man in a retro suit, with lens distortion, sun flare, briefcase, opulent interior, cool blue/amber palette and art-house aesthetic.
единицы.цитата: This cinematic still, crafted with a wide-angle lens from an extremely low perspective, dramatically captures a young, slender man standing confidently. The camera is angled sharply upwards, making him appear towering and powerful, with his entire body filling the frame from his bell-bottomed trousers to his shaggy, sun-kissed hair. He's dressed in a light blue suit with subtle vertical stripes and a vibrant, gold-toned floral patterned shirt and tie, radiating a distinct retro vibe. The low angle distorts his legs, making them appear elongated and creating a dynamic sense of depth. His expression is obscured by circular, wire-rimmed glasses and the bright, golden sunlight flaring intensely from behind his right shoulder, creating significant lens flares and a hazy, dreamlike ambiance. His left hand is casually slipped into his trouser pocket, while his right hand loosely clutches a worn, reddish-brown leather briefcase. The background hints at a grand, somewhat opulent interior with arched windows reflecting the bright sky and a pale blue ceiling, typical of an elegant, older building. The lighting is bold and expressive, reminiscent of a highly stylized period drama, with a color palette dominated by cool blues and warm amber tones from the sunlight, lending the image a nostalgic, slightly surreal quality, characteristic of a classic art house aesthetic.
единицы.заметка: Объектив и ракурс названы первыми, затем их следствия описаны явно ('making him appear towering', 'The low angle distorts his legs, making them appear elongated'); лицо скрыто очками и бликом ('lens flares'); свет 'reminiscent of a highly stylized period drama'; палитра двумя полюсами (cool blues / warm amber).

единицы.утверждение_en: Example prompt: an ethereal cinematic portrait at a slightly low angle, subject partly hidden behind translucent vertical panels with a left-to-right cream→yellow→orange→red gradient, gently blurred face, downward gaze.
единицы.цитата: This cinematic still presents a compelling, ethereal portrait, captured with a slightly low-angle perspective that lends the subject an air of quiet contemplation. The composition is reminiscent of a master cinematographer's work, utilizing strong vertical elements to create a sense of depth and visual rhythm. The subject, a person with soft features and a subtle expression, is partially obscured by a series of translucent, vertical panels that span the frame. These panels transition in color from a pale, creamy white on the far left, through warm shades of yellow and orange, to deep, rich reds on the right, creating a striking gradient that bathes the scene in a warm, autumnal glow. The person's face is rendered with a gentle blur, suggesting movement or a dreamlike state, with only the soft contours of their nose, mouth, and chin clearly discernible. Their gaze is directed slightly downwards and to the right, hinting at introspection or a moment of quiet reflection. They wear what appears to be a light-colored, possibly pleated garment, the folds of which are also subtly blurred by the vertical elements. The overall ambiance is one of introspective beauty and a delicate sense of mystery, evoking a mood that is both intimate and expansive, like a moment suspended in time within a poignant drama.
единицы.заметка: Ссылка на безымянного автора ('reminiscent of a master cinematographer's work'); приём — полупрозрачный передний план с упорядоченным градиентом ('from a pale, creamy white on the far left… to deep, rich reds on the right'); размытие лица задано как намеренное ('suggesting movement or a dreamlike state'); направление взгляда.

единицы.утверждение_en: Example prompt: a close-up dreamlike photograph of 'what appears to be a neural network' as glass neurons with glowing orange cores, very shallow depth of field with warm/cool bokeh, amber palette, dynamic composition.
единицы.цитата: This is a close-up, dreamlike photograph of what appears to be a neural network, bathed in a warm, golden light. The main subjects are translucent, glass-like structures resembling neurons, interconnected by thin, stretching filaments. Inside each of these neuron-like spheres is a bright, glowing core of orange light, casting a radiant glow. The surfaces of these structures have a complex, textured quality, almost like spun glass or crystalline formations. The depth of field is very shallow, causing the foreground elements to be in sharp focus while the background dissolves into a soft, blurry bokeh of warm orange and cool blue-white lights. This creates a strong sense of depth and a magical, ethereal atmosphere. The overall color palette is dominated by shades of orange, gold, and amber, contrasted with hints of cool blue and silver, which adds to the otherworldly feel of the image. The lighting is soft and diffused, yet the points of light within the neurons are intense and star-like, suggesting energy and activity within this intricate web. The composition is dynamic, with the interconnected forms leading the eye throughout the frame, suggesting a complex and living system.
единицы.заметка: Абстракция превращена в физические объекты (стеклянные нейроны, нити, светящиеся ядра) + фактура ('spun glass or crystalline formations') + оптика ('The depth of field is very shallow… background dissolves into a soft, blurry bokeh') + палитра с контрастом + свет + композиция, ведущая взгляд.

единицы.утверждение_en: Example prompt: a short stylized studio portrait 'resembling a cinematic still with bold color choices' of a woman in profile facing upper right, head tilted up, eyes closed.
единицы.цитата: This is a strikingly vibrant, highly stylized studio portrait, resembling a cinematic still with bold color choices. The subject, a woman with very dark skin and closely cropped, dark hair, is captured in profile, facing towards the upper right of the frame. Her head is tilted upwards, and her eyes are closed, lending an air of serene contemplation or dramatic emotion.
единицы.заметка: Короткий промпт: жанр + субъект + поза/направление ('in profile, facing towards the upper right of the frame', 'head is tilted upwards', 'eyes are closed'). По alt (37) в результате бирюзово-пурпурный контровой свет на тёмном фоне — в тексте промпта этого нет (либо промпт на странице усечён, либо свет выбран моделью по 'bold color choices').

единицы.утверждение_en: Example prompt: a cinematic medium shot of a man on worn metal stairs, low angle looking up, patterned reddish-brown suit and floral shirt, direct gaze, brick building left and blue sky right, railing mirroring the stairs, strong diagonals and deep focus.
единицы.цитата: This cinematic still captures a striking medium shot of a man seated on worn metal stairs, bathed in the strong, cinematic light of a bright day with a slight sense of melancholy. The camera is positioned at a low angle, looking upwards towards the subject, lending him an imposing and almost confrontational presence. He is dressed in a meticulously patterned, reddish-brown suit, the intricate design of which is visible even from a distance. Beneath the suit jacket, a floral button-up shirt with muted yellow, green, and red tones adds a subtle pop of color, complementing the suit without overpowering it. His dark skin glows under the bright illumination, and his gaze is directed straight at the viewer, conveying a sense of quiet confidence. His dark, textured hair, possibly dreadlocks, frames his face. The background features a weathered brick building on the left, its red tones contrasting with the vibrant blue sky and fluffy white clouds visible above on the right. A white, slightly rusted metal railing runs down the right side of the frame, mirroring the angle of the stairs. The overall color palette is warm and earthy, dominated by shades of red, brown, and blue, with hints of yellow and white. The composition, with its strong diagonals and deep focus, contributes to a sense of profound character study.
единицы.заметка: План + место + свет/настроение в первой фразе → ракурс с эффектом ('imposing and almost confrontational presence') → одежда → кожа/взгляд ('directed straight at the viewer') → волосы → раскладка фона по сторонам кадра ('on the left', 'above on the right') → рифма линий ('railing… mirroring the angle of the stairs') → палитра → композиция ('strong diagonals and deep focus').

единицы.утверждение_en: Example prompt: a slightly low-angle cinematic still, 'reminiscent of a poetic art-house film', of an orange flower seen through ribbed glass with a shadowy figure behind, warm subject vs cool background, leading lines and shallow depth of field.
единицы.цитата: This cinematic still, captured with a slightly low-angle perspective, presents a dreamlike and abstract composition, reminiscent of a poetic art-house film. The scene is dominated by a soft, diffused light, creating an ethereal ambiance. The color palette is muted yet warm, featuring gentle oranges and yellows for the central subject, contrasted with cool blues and subtle greys in the background. The primary subject is a large, vibrant orange flower, seen through a textured, ribbed glass or translucent surface. This surface distorts the flower into a series of undulating vertical segments, giving it a soft, almost painterly quality. The petals appear full and layered, their warmth radiating softly through the diffusion. Behind the flower, a shadowy, indistinct human figure is visible, also fragmented and stretched by the ribbed surface. The figure's silhouette is dark, providing a strong contrast to the bright flower and hinting at a mysterious presence. The vertical lines of the textured glass create a sense of movement and depth, pulling the viewer's eye across the frame. The overall mood is one of quiet contemplation and subtle beauty, evoking a sense of intimacy and introspection, as if glimpsing a private moment through a veil. The composition uses leading lines and a shallow depth of field to draw focus to the delicate interplay between the flower and the obscured figure, creating a visually rich and emotionally resonant image.
единицы.заметка: Оптический приём назван материалом ('seen through a textured, ribbed glass or translucent surface') и его действием ('distorts the flower into a series of undulating vertical segments'); тёплый объект против холодного фона; композиционные средства названы прямо ('leading lines and a shallow depth of field').

единицы.утверждение_en: Example prompt: an aerial shot of a misty valley with rolling green hills, winding water, clouds on peaks, soft diffused light, planes described foreground → right side → further in the valley, ending with a place-mood anchor (Scottish Highlands / Lake District).
единицы.цитата: This aerial shot captures a dramatic, misty landscape, likely a valley or glen, characterized by rolling, verdant hills and a winding river or loch. The photography style leans towards a moody and atmospheric aesthetic, emphasizing the grandeur and isolation of nature. The camera angle is high, looking down into the valley, providing a sweeping panoramic view that highlights the immense scale of the surroundings. The dominant colors are various shades of deep green, ranging from lush emerald in the foreground fields to darker, more muted tones on the distant mountains. The water, a central feature, appears as a serene, dark blue-grey, reflecting the overcast sky. The sky itself is a blend of grey and white, heavily laden with clouds and mist that cling to the mountain peaks, creating a soft, diffused lighting style. This natural, soft light minimizes harsh shadows and enhances the overall ethereal feel of the scene. The subject is a majestic natural landscape. In the foreground, a darker body of water curves around a patch of bright green fields, bordered by scattered trees and shrubs. A narrow, winding road snakes through the green hills on the right side of the frame, disappearing into the distance. Further into the valley, a larger, lighter blue-grey body of water stretches between towering, green-clad mountains. These mountains rise steeply on both sides, their peaks shrouded in the low-hanging mist, creating a sense of depth and mystery. The overall impression is one of serene, untamed wilderness, hinting at the rugged beauty of places like the Scottish Highlands or the Lake District.
единицы.заметка: Тип кадра ('aerial shot') → стиль ('moody and atmospheric') → ракурс ('high, looking down into the valley… sweeping panoramic view') → цвета от переднего плана к дальнему → вода, небо, туман → свет → планы по глубине ('In the foreground… on the right side of the frame… Further into the valley') → общее впечатление с географическим якорем ('hinting at… the Scottish Highlands or the Lake District').

единицы.утверждение_en: Example prompt: 'Cinematic still in the style of a dreamlike portrait' lit by a setting sun through tall grasses, ornate collar and earrings, blurred field, close-up of face and upper body, explicitly stating 'The lighting is the key element'.
единицы.цитата: Cinematic still in the style of a dreamlike portrait, illuminated by the warm hues of a setting sun filtering through tall grasses. The subject, a person with sleek dark hair, is positioned amongst the golden stalks, their face catching the soft, glowing light. They are adorned with an intricately embellished collar and large, ornate earrings that add a touch of opulence to the natural setting. The background is a blurred expanse of field and sky, creating a sense of depth and isolating the subject in a moment of serene beauty. The lighting is the key element, casting a warm, almost ethereal glow on the skin and highlighting the textures of the grasses and the jewelry. The composition is a close-up, focusing on the subject's face and upper body, reminiscent of the evocative and painterly portraits captured by a visually sensitive filmmaker. The ambiance is one of magical realism and tranquil beauty, where the natural and the ornate blend seamlessly in the soft light.
единицы.заметка: Промпт прямо называет приоритет ('The lighting is the key element, casting a warm, almost ethereal glow…'); кадрирование задано ('a close-up, focusing on the subject's face and upper body'); ссылка на безымянного автора ('a visually sensitive filmmaker'); фон размыт для изоляции субъекта.

единицы.утверждение_en: Example prompt: a cinematic still 'in the style of a vibrant, avant-garde art film' of a spinning woman in a red embroidered gown, low angle, intentional motion blur on fabric, cool teal/blue abstract background.
единицы.цитата: This cinematic still, in the style of a vibrant, avant-garde art film, captures a dynamic moment reminiscent of a bold, experimental visual storyteller's work. The camera is angled from a low perspective, looking upwards at a young woman caught in a blurred motion, giving the impression of exhilarating speed or a sudden, graceful turn. Her eyes are closed, head slightly tilted back, and lips softly parted, suggesting a moment of profound immersion or a dramatic exhalation. She is adorned in a striking, voluminous gown, predominantly a rich, saturated red, with the bodice and high collar intricately embellished with a riot of intensely colorful floral embroidery\xe2\x80\x94hues of yellow, blue, green, and pink exploding against the fiery red. The fabric of her dress, especially the sleeves and lower skirt, is dramatically streaked and blurred by the motion, creating a sense of fluidity and energy that radiates outwards from her form. The background is an abstract blur of cool tones, with swathes of deep teal and lighter, almost ethereal blues, suggesting an environment that is fast-moving or out of focus, further emphasizing the woman as the sharp, albeit moving, subject. The overall ambiance is one of intoxicating freedom, passionate expression, and dreamlike exhilaration, underscored by the blurred edges and intense color palette, conveying a breathtaking, ephemeral instant.
единицы.заметка: Движение задано как намеренное размытие ('caught in a blurred motion', 'dramatically streaked and blurred by the motion') при резком субъекте ('the sharp, albeit moving, subject'); тёплый субъект на холодном фоне. В .txt в тексте промпта буквально стоит последовательность '\xe2\x80\x94' (битое тире) — цитата сохранена как в файле.

единицы.утверждение_en: Example prompt: 'Cinematic still in the style of an emotionally resonant independent drama' — a wide, slightly low-angle shot of an unconventional copper/terracotta curved building with glass façade reflecting pastel sky, domes and a smokestack.
единицы.цитата: Cinematic still in the style of an emotionally resonant independent drama, this is a wide, slightly low-angle shot of a strikingly unconventional building, meticulously composed with a sense of serene majesty. The building, a captivating blend of organic and industrial, dominates the left and center. Its walls are clad in a rich, weathered orange-red, reminiscent of aged copper or terracotta, with sweeping, undulating curves that give it a soft, almost molten appearance. Large sections of its fa\xc3\xa7ade are glass, reflecting the soft, pastel hues of the sky \xe2\x80\x93 pale pinks and light lavenders \xe2\x80\x93 and the green foliage of trees lining the bank to its left. At the top of the building, a series of rounded domes and a tall, slender smokestack-like structure add to its unique silhouette.
единицы.заметка: Жанр + план + ракурс → размещение объекта в кадре ('dominates the left and center') → материалы/цвета → отражения в стекле → силуэт крыши. По alt (42) в результате есть река, сумерки и идущий человек — в тексте промпта их нет (возможно, текст на странице усечён). В .txt битые последовательности 'fa\xc3\xa7ade', '\xe2\x80\x93' — цитата как в файле.

единицы.утверждение_en: Use detailed prompts to take more control over the images you generate: think about what you want to see — the characters, the setting, and the overall feel; the more detail you add, the closer the image will be to what you imagined.
единицы.цитата: Use detailed prompts to take more control over the images you generate. Think about what you want to see – the characters, the setting, and the overall feel. The more detail you add, the closer the image will be to what you’ve imagined.
единицы.заметка: Единственный прямой совет по промптингу на странице; три опоры — персонажи, место, общее ощущение.

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: Greeting-card prompts on the page follow one order: card type + placement on a surface → design character → palette of three named colors → central graphic (sometimes with an 'or' alternative) → first text in quotes + font → second message in quotes + font → card stock / finish → closing 'overall impression' sentence.
длинная_дистанция.заметка: Общая структура пяти промптов; дословно на странице не сформулирована.

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: In every text-rendering example the exact words are given in quotation marks and each text string is paired with its own typography description (serif / sans-serif / script, weight, color or foil) and often its position (above/below, arched along a curve, split top/bottom, stacked left-aligned).

Cinematic examples share an order: medium label ('Cinematic still' / 'This cinematic still') + genre reference (surreal dream sequence, art-house, period drama, independent drama) → shot size and camera angle/lens with its effect → subject and wardrobe → background → lighting → palette → composition → overall mood; style is invoked through genre or unnamed filmmakers ('a master cinematographer', 'a visually sensitive filmmaker'), never by a real name.

Infographic examples name the format (isometric cutaway, triptych, flat lay DIY infographic, storybook infographic), enumerate the parts or labels to show (often quoted), state the style — sometimes as 'The style is <name>, characterized by…' — and give a palette; process topics encode order through direction or a connecting path ('left to right', 'then to… and finally').

Consistency prompts state the subject count, what must stay fixed and what may vary, and duplicates to avoid: 'It is strictly important to keep identity (and attire) consistent of all the 14 characters'; 'Keep the attire and identity consistent… but their expressions and angles should vary'; 'only have one of each character in each image'; references are pointed to as 'these' characters.

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: For real named places the examples explicitly tell the model to search before drawing ('Your plan is to first search for visual references, and generate after'), which matches the page's claim that Nano Banana 2 uses real-time web information and images for more accurate renderings of specific subjects.
On this page the aspect ratio is stated inside the prompt text ('Aspect ratio 16:9', '16:9 aspect ratio', 'in 16:9 format'); no API parameter for aspect ratio or resolution is shown.
длинная_дистанция.заметка: Про параметр вызова страница молчит — только текст промпта.

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: Localization is demonstrated as a multi-turn edit: first generate the image, then a short follow-up that refers to 'this concept'/'this image', names the target setting/environment, says to translate 'all the text' to a named language, and optionally adds a preservation clause ('keep the same text style').

The capabilities the page advertises most (legible/localized text, data infographics, real-world knowledge, consistency, blending) are the same areas its Limitations section flags (spelling, small faces, translation grammar and idioms, factual errors in infographics, blending artifacts, inconsistent characters) — so outputs in these areas need verification.

Per the page's own charts, Nano Banana 2 leads overall Elo for generation and editing at lower latency, while Gemini 3 Pro Image renders both short and long in-image text with fewer errors; long text in non-Latin scripts is weak for most models including Nano Banana 2.
длинная_дистанция.заметка: Сопоставление графиков; выбор модели под текст на странице прямо не рекомендуется.
